description: Finds which venues sell a dish or cuisine, such as pizza or biryani, by searching the menus of live venues in a city or country (never event organisers). Returns, for each venue that has a match, the venue (with whether it delivers and whether it is open now) and up to a few matching items with price and whether they have required choices. Use list_menu_items with the venue id for the full item and its options. Matches marked soldAheadOnly are sold only for a scheduled date and can't be ordered through the assistant yet. Uses a search index, so it covers every live venue quickly: venues come back best match first, at most maxVenues of them, and the result says how many venues had a match. A city or countryCode narrows it and is recommended, because dish names are the same everywhere.

openNow.description: true: only venues open right now

query.description: A dish or cuisine, e.g. pizza, biryani, burger. Every word must appear in the item's name, category or description

name: search_menu
title: Search menus across venues
